Cyrus (Japanese: タマキ Tamaki) is a character of the day who appeared in the episode Grin to Win!. He is Sonrisa's neighbor and, like many of the people in Bloomingvale, a . He is known to have won the Sunflora of the Year award three times.

==History==
In the episode Grin to Win!, broke into Cyrus's greenhouse, hoping to steal a Sunflora for the upcoming Sunflora Festival. Cyrus was alerted to the heist after inadvertently activated the alarm. While Jessie and James escaped, Cyrus found Meowth trapped in a net and tied him up on discovery. , upon whispering her plan to , told Cyrus that Meowth was an innocent Pokémon that must have been corrupted by the two that ran away, and convinced him to transfer Meowth into their custody.

Later, Meowth translated to Sonrisa that her Sunflora, nicknamed Sunny, had been so gloomy lately because another Sunflora it used to play around with, Cyrus's earlier Sunflora called Gwendela, was not around anymore. The group asked Cyrus where Gwendela was, and Cyrus explained that he had traded that Sunflora yesterday for one of Nurse Joy's Pokémon. Later, at the competition, Cyrus was one of the final contestants for the prize. His participating Dorabelle was shown to be humongous in comparison to regular Sunflora, being taller than an average-sized person. Cyrus and Dorabelle went on to lose to Sonrisa and Sunny.
